# Poly Haven PBR assets

These texture assets are used by `blender/house_story.py` to render the
architectural model. They are vendored so local and CI renders do not depend on
an external API.

All listed assets are published by Poly Haven under **CC0**. Attribution is not
required, but the source is retained for traceability:

- `concrete_wall_009` — https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_009
- `oak_veneer_01` — https://polyhaven.com/a/oak_veneer_01
- `grey_roof_01` — https://polyhaven.com/a/grey_roof_01
- License — https://polyhaven.com/license

Each folder contains the 1K diffuse, roughness and OpenGL-normal maps. The
original filenames are preserved.
